items.title: Observed gains from individual misranked DR actions

source.label: Final-checkpoint paired action audit

metricDefinitions.label: Single-action generalized cost reduction
metricDefinitions.definition: A first-step effective action changes by 1 kW; subsequent steps use the unchanged deterministic policy. Reward gain is converted with scale 100.

caveats: Single-action counterfactual gains overlap and must not be summed over a day.
Generalized cost contains noncash penalties and is not accounting profit.
No retrained policy has been evaluated.

evidenceFlow.title: Cost identity
evidenceFlow.text: All 326 pair rows reconcile reward gains to saved cost-component deltas within 1e-8.

items.title: Hypothetical recovery of part of the broader reference gap

source.label: 55-day formal test

metricDefinitions.label: Baseline generalized daily cost
metricDefinitions.definition: Mean generalized system cost across the 55 formal-test dates.

metricDefinitions.label: Recovery scenario
metricDefinitions.definition: Assumed fraction of the mean algorithm-minus-reference cost gap recovered, divided by baseline mean cost.

caveats: Scenarios are assumptions, not forecasts or confidence intervals.
Reference allocation differs from online clearing; the gap is not an achievable Critic-only bound.
Single-action counterfactual gains overlap and must not be summed over a day.
Generalized cost contains noncash penalties and is not accounting profit.
No retrained policy has been evaluated.

preview.note: Illustrative scenarios based on observed baseline values.

methods.code:
gap = mean(algorithm_generalized_system_cost) - mean(generalized_reference_cost)
saving = gap * assumed_recovery_fraction
percent = 100 * saving / mean(algorithm_generalized_system_cost)

evidenceFlow.title: Baseline reconciliation
evidenceFlow.text: 55 unique dates; both recomputed means match the formal summary within 1e-9. All daily reward/cost identities match within 1e-8.
